criteria.name: Data Understanding & Quality Checks
criteria.guidance: Inspect the supplied demographic, purchase and review datasets; validate schema, keys, duplicates, missingness, target and join cardinality.

criteria.name: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
criteria.guidance: Use appropriate univariate/bivariate analysis and plots to explain purchase patterns by customer and product categories.

criteria.name: Data Cleaning & Feature Engineering
criteria.guidance: Justify missing-value handling, categorical encoding, feature creation and leakage prevention; retain appropriate records.

criteria.name: Regression Baseline
criteria.guidance: Build a valid regression baseline for Purchase with train/test separation and preprocessing fitted on training data.

criteria.name: Evaluation & Findings
criteria.guidance: Report MAE, RMSE and R², interpret errors and findings, and state limitations without unsupported business claims.
